div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 1. UNDERSTAND: What exactly is being claimed? Restate it charitably.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 2. CLASSIFY: What kind of disagreement is it? Fact, concept, value, prediction, policy?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 3. MAP: What are the premises, including hidden ones? How do they connect?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 4. EVALUATE THE REASONING: Valid or strong? Premises acceptable, relevant, sufficient? Fallacies?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 5. EVALUATE THE EVIDENCE: Sources? Study quality? Base rates? Alternatives?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 6. FIND THE CRUX: What single point, if settled, would change someone's mind?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 7. CONCLUDE: How confident should I be? What would change my mind?
